rationale: Operator answer 2026-11-04 in the planner session, via the decision rubric. Problem: verify reruns the full chain after every developer return, up to about five runs per task. Counter-argument: verify is the only machine check before reviewers sign (AISDLC-1086), and an affected-set bug fails open silently. Why it survives: CI runs the full suite before merge, so a miss costs one red CI run, not a bad merge; the first round is always full, root gates, build, lint and format always run, and any root, config, lockfile or non-package path change or an unreadable record forces a full run. Narrows a control, hence the weakening tag.
